descriptions.text: Sudoswap imitation disk Sudorare is suspected to have a Rug Pull, and the Looks, WETH and XMON tokens in the contract address were transferred to the first 0xbb42 address (0xbb42f789b39af41b796f6C28D4c4aa5aCE389d8A), and then sold for ETH on Uniswap, with a total profit of about 519.5 ETH (about 800,000 US dollars) , the Sudorare website and Twitter account are now inaccessible. ‎According to the analysis, the initial deployment funds came from the exchange Kraken.

SudoRare, an NFT automated market maker on Ethereum, performed an exit scam on 23 August 2022 by exploiting upgradeable contract privileges to drain user deposits of roughly $800,000 to $852,000. The funds were withdrawn into three operator-controlled accounts within hours of launch. The SudoRare team retained unchecked upgrade access, which they used to introduce and execute a privileged contract function enabling the withdrawal of all user-deposited assets.
